items.summary: Update the on-device fusion generator so outputs are true fusions derived from BOTH Photo A and Photo B (a combined composite/collage/merge), not primarily global color adjustments or a simple uniform overlay; ensure the generator frequently exchanges/merges localized structures/textures between the two inputs (e.g., patch-based region mixing + edge-aware blending) so the result visibly contains meaningful elements from each input.

Add an on-device “both-inputs” contribution guard to detect and prevent outputs that are effectively identical to just Photo A or just Photo B (aside from minor global color/contrast changes); when detected, automatically retry with a different fusion recipe/seed until a maximum retry count is reached, then show a clear English error message if it cannot produce a valid fusion.

Update Upload/Generate page user-facing copy to define “fusion” in plain English as a combined result derived from BOTH photos (not a filter), and align button/section descriptions accordingly without introducing new workflow steps.
